name: Quick launch
author: Nate
description: A Launch tab with the apps you pin, each with its icon or a picture you choose. Pick them from the Start menu or paste a path or link, then open them with one click.

settings.label: Layout
settings.description: Pictures shows each app's icon above its button. Compact puts several buttons on a row, without pictures.

settings.label: Also show pinned apps on the Plugins tab
Show a notice in the pill when an app opens
